title: eduatilab/spotlight pipeline parameters
description: Computational framework (SPoTLIghT) to derive spatial graph-based interpretable features from H&E (fresh-frozen, FF) tissue slides.

spotlight.title: SPoTLIghT
spotlight.description: Parameters that are used in multiple modules

cancer_type.description: abbreviation of cancer type, using TCGA abbreviations

slide_type.description: Slide type, i.e. FFPE or FF

is_tcga.description: Indicate whether the H&E images are from the TCGA

tumor_purity_threshold.description: Minimum tumor purity for a slide to be kept (default=80)

clinical_file_path.description: Path to clinical file (`.csv`), at least have the following columns: 'sample_submitter_id' and 'slide_submitter_id'. If **module `extracthistopatho`** is run, setting this parameter is **optional**.

out_prefix.description: Prefix to use for selection of outputs

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

save_tf_records.description: save TF records in processing step.

clinical_files_input.description: If clinical file is available, i.e. previously generated, please indicate path to the file here. If given, it should be a csv.

is_tumor.description: Indicates whether the tissue is classified as tumour.

clinical_file_out_file.description: Name to use for generated clinical file.

checkpoint_path.description: checkpoints of DL model, see the Tensorflow repository [tensorflow/models](https://github.com/tensorflow/models/tree/master/research/slim#Pretrained). Checkpoint used in manuscript can be downloaded via this [link](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/files/S-BSST292/Retrained_Inception_v4.zip) and can be found here: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/biostudies/bioimages/studies/S-BSST292. Of note, the path should point to the **directory** with the checkpoint files.

gradient_mag_filter.description: Minimum gradient magnitude, used for filtering non-informative and/or blurry tiles (default=10)

n_shards.description: number of shards for creating TFrecords (default=320)

model_name.description: Name of model used, ensure this corresponds to the model of the checkpoints (default="inception_v4")

deconv_tools.description: Deconvolution tools to use, please not that for build multi-task models you need all tools.

is_tpm.description: Indicate whether given `gene_exp_path` is TPM normalized (default=false)

mcp_probesets.description: File called "probesets.txt" needed for MCPCounter. This file is provided.

mcp_genes.description: File called "genes.txt" needed for MCPCounter. This file is provided

thorsson_scores_path.description: Path to scores Thorsson Scores. These can be downloaded from [ref](https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/panimmune) - download the 'ABSOLUTE purity/ploidy' file, or use [direct link](https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/4f277128-f793-4354-a13d-30cc7fe9f6b5). Unzip if necessary as the .tsv extension is required

estimate_scores_path.description: Path to ESTIMATE scores. These can be downloaded from [link](https://bioinformatics.mdanderson.org/estimate/index.html) - Download the relevant file for the cancer type of interest, use the RNA-seqV2 column on the page.

absolute_tumor_purity_path.description: Path to ABSOLUTE tumor purity scores. These can be downloaded from [link](https://gdc.cancer.gov/about-data/publications/panimmune) - Download the 'Score for 160 Genes Signatures in Tumor Samples' or use [direct link](https://api.gdc.cancer.gov/data/80a82092-161d-4615-9d96-e858f113618d)

gibbons_scores_path.description: Path to Gibbons scores (see [reference](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5503821/). Download the 'Supp Datafile S1.' or use the (direct link)[https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5503821/bin/NIHMS840944-supplement-Supp_Datafile_S1.xlsx]

module_build_multi_task_cell_type_models.title: Module - Build Multi-Task Cell Type Models

bottleneck_features_path.description: Path to extracted histopathological features, generated by **module `extracthistopatho`**

target_features_path.description: Path to target features, i.e. the cell type deconvolution results.

model_cell_types.description: String of cell types for which a multi-task models has to be build (default="CAFs, Endothelial_cells, T_cells, tumor_purity")

n_tiles.description: Number of tiles selected per slide (default=50)

celltype_models_path.description: Path to directory with the models for each cell type, where each cell type has to have its own folder. For an example of the structure see provided models [assets/TF_models/SKCM_FF](../assets/TF_models/SKCM_FF)

spatialfeatures.description: what type of spatial features to generate: 'cluster' and/or 'graph'. If both, use comma to separate

cluster_based_features.description: Path to computed cluster-based features if previously generated

graph_based_features.description: Path to computed graph-based features if previously generated

is_model_dir.description: Indicate whether your 'model_dir' contains subdirectories. In most use-cases use 'False'

tile_level_celltype_predictions.description: Predicted cell type abundances from H&E (predict tiles module), i.e. '<prefix>_tile_predictions_proba.csv

graphs_path.description: Path to file (`.pkl`) with the graphs for all slides. Not required, if left default or if not set, this will be generated.

abundance_threshold.description: Min. abundance (probability) for assigning cell type (default=0.5)

metadata_path.description: Path to file with metadata NOT USED

merge_var.description: Variable for merging metadata and spatial features, (default="slide_submitter_id")

sheet_name.description: If `metadata_path` points to an Excel file, give the 'sheet_name' to read from.
